name: Issue resolution desk
description: A config-driven, repo-agnostic issue-resolution desk. A GitHub issue (bound to a task by the github sync) is picked up by an implementer Claude Code agent that runs in the platform's own ephemeral sandbox on the user's BYO Claude credentials: it derives the repo from the issue, clones it, fixes the issue on a tale/<id> branch, runs the project's OWN tests to verify, commits, pushes (broker-injected github token + the in-image credential helper, private repos included), and opens a pull request. A separate reviewer agent fetches the PR, re-runs the tests, and posts review comments. A toolless LLM judge then reads the review and decides merge-readiness: if yes, the task parks at In review and the workflow ends (the human merges); if no, it loops back to the implementer with the review feedback, repeating until the judge approves. Cross-step state lives on the git branch + PR; the per-step sandboxes are stateless. Every step carries ui/role annotations so the generic operator workspace renders it with no per-vertical UI code.

steps.name: Implementer resolves the issue & opens/updates the PR

config.description: A sandbox step always returns the success port; the real verdict is in output.data.ok. Stop if the implementer failed to push a verified fix + PR.

parameters.body: [automated] The implementer could not resolve this issue: {{steps.implement.output.data.error || steps.implement.output.data.summary || 'no output'}} — returned to To do.

steps.name: Reviewer re-tests & comments on the PR

run.instructions: Review the implementer's fix for '{{input.task.title}}' (#{{input.task.number}}) at {{input.task.externalUrl}} on branch `tale/{{input.task._id}}`. Git is authenticated ($GITHUB_TOKEN + helper). Do: (1) derive the repo URL from the issue URL and `git clone <repo> repo && cd repo`; (2) `git fetch origin tale/{{input.task._id}} && git checkout tale/{{input.task._id}}`; (3) review the change for correctness and run the project's OWN tests; (4) post your review as comments on the pull request (`gh pr review` / `gh pr comment`, or the GitHub REST API with $GITHUB_TOKEN) — do NOT change or push code, the implementer fixes. MANDATORY: write your findings to /user/output/summary.md (absolute path): clearly state whether the change is ready to merge or what specifically must be fixed.

config.name: merge-judge
config.systemPrompt: You are a strict merge gate for a code-review desk. You are given ONLY the reviewer's written summary of a proposed fix. Decide whether it is ready to merge: approve only when the reviewer reports no blocking problems and the tests pass. You have no tools and must judge solely from the summary. Reply with EXACTLY one lowercase word and nothing else: yes (ready to merge) or no (needs more work).

config.description: The judge replies with a bare yes/no (trimmed); jexl `in` does substring, and a 'no' can never contain 'yes', so this never false-approves. If yes, park for human merge; otherwise loop back to the implementer with the review feedback (bounded by the workflow timeout).

steps.name: Park at In review (await human merge)
